source: Owner answer Q-87 (K59, 25 October 2026): every realm has a pre-built, named heir, but succession is dynamic and can fail into crisis. Owner answer Q-104 (K54): only eight women remain, so every heir is a man (or, for the ents and the Baelim, of no sex, as their rulers are). Every heir here is proposed (canon P): name, office, birth and text are ZIN's, written in each realm's naming style from its court in data/world/characters.
note: loadCharacterData (modules/characters.mjs) sets each entry as the heir of the realm whose court names no heir; the court's own heir note stays the design note. `custom` is the realm's custom of succession for realm life (blood: an ordered line by blood, age or pact; elective: a moot, a council or a guild chooses, and the heir is its favoured candidate; contested: the crown is taken in the ring or by the biggest; open: the custom is not told to men). `portraitPending` marks an heir the portrait plan (data/world/portrait_pools.json, owned by the portrait work) does not list yet: characters.mjs gives him a free member of his culture pool until the plan lists him. No heir: Yeldenne (retired, K56), Puvulan, the Worshipdom and Zol's Mistake (their rulers are the story's), Gala (who follows Lorien is left to the owner), the Nether (open in the vault), the God Forest and the Mushroom Forest (no ruler named), Goldoroth (the Dark Lands mechanic names its heir, zin_goldoroth.2).

melkgard.name: Ulvran of the Third Fort
melkgard.role: The ablest of the captains sworn to Ezhan, and the one the forts drink to when the warlord is out of earshot; the oath-companies will still have to raise him over the pyre.
melkgard.succession: Chosen by the oath-companies over the warlord's pyre; no family holds Melkgard.
melkgard.portrait: A hard young captain in a mail hauberk and a fur-lined oath-cloak, an iron fort-badge at the throat.

horidor.name: Kerdan Azling
horidor.role: The chief's sister-son, who has walked every cairn of the gap and is the name the cairn moot hears most often, though it has never chosen before a chief was cold.
horidor.succession: Chosen by the cairn moot of Ollondo, most often from the Azling hearth-line.
horidor.portrait: A lean young clansman in grey furs with a cairn-stone pendant and wind-burned cheeks.

fearno.name: Aldvar Azening
fearno.role: Ulvald's cousin, who keeps the steading while the first lord sits at Azenoalion and expects the steading lords to choose him when the seven winters run out.
fearno.succession: A first lord is chosen for seven winters by the steading lords at Azenoalion.
fearno.portrait: A broad steading lord in a wolf-skin mantle with a steward's key-ring.

poloto.name: Kolbran Margak
poloto.role: The harbour-master's nephew has passed every test of the harbour guild and sits on its bench, and the masters say the harbour book would be safe with him.
poloto.succession: The pilots' guild of Fandhavn chooses a Harbour-Master for life from its masters.
poloto.portrait: A weathered pilot in an oiled blue coat with a sounding-line coiled at his belt.

glimkit.name: Snarkit the Wide
glimkit.role: The biggest of the warren bosses after Plickit himself, and he makes sure everyone notices; the warrens have not agreed on him yet, which among hobgoblins is the same as having a quarrel ready.
glimkit.succession: The warrens choose the biggest hobgoblin they can agree on.
glimkit.portrait: A huge hobgoblin with a lamp-hook over one shoulder and a grin full of filed teeth.

xison.name: Ezhvar Esroming
xison.house: the Esroming hearth of the Rion moors
xison.role: Ezhim's younger brother keeps the road-tolls of the Rion moors and is spoken of at Akahew as the next speaker, though the road-moot has never liked choosing one hearth twice.
xison.succession: The road-moot chooses a speaker for three Long Lights at a time.
xison.portrait: A moor-reeve in a heavy felt coat with a toll-tally on a thong.

omar.name: Kerdak, Nephew of Grinor
omar.role: The eldest of the three nephews who came back from their winter alone on the moor, and the one with the most frost-scarred hands to show for it.
omar.succession: The clan moot chooses from Kerdok's descendants who have spent a winter alone on the moor.
omar.portrait: A gaunt young clansman with frost-scarred hands and a bearskin over his shoulders.

portogalor.name: Kerdir Azlak
portogalor.office: Keeper of the Hall of Fellodor
portogalor.role: Kerdan's younger son, who keeps the hall while his brother Brandur keeps the fleet; the sealing captains will choose between them, and the hall knows which of them stayed home.
portogalor.succession: The sealing captains choose the lord from the Azlak family.
portogalor.portrait: A young lord in sealskin and wool with a hall-keeper's staff.

kvittumm.name: Haldsten Grinson
kvittumm.role: Haldar's son counts more reindeer than any herder of the winter moot and knows it; if the moot ever tires of his father, it need not look far.
kvittumm.succession: The winter moot chooses a moot-chief each Long Dark from the herders with the largest herd or the most respect.
kvittumm.portrait: A herder in a reindeer-hide coat with antler toggles and a tally-stick.

orewele.name: Kolvan Siulak
orewele.role: Kolvar's son, sent down the dwarf factor's shafts for three seasons so that the factor would know his face when the clan chooses.
orewele.succession: The clan chooses from the Siulak family, and the dwarf factor must accept the choice.
orewele.portrait: A soot-streaked young miner in a leather hood with a lamp on a chain.

nivaros.name: Hukar the Younger
nivaros.role: The Frost-King's sister-son, who carries the ice-throne's stones up the stair at Xitore each winter; the cairn-keepers have watched him do it longer than men keep count.
nivaros.succession: The cairn-keepers choose the Frost-King and enthrone him on the ice-throne at Xitore.
nivaros.portrait: A primeval ice giant with a frost-rimed beard and a block of blue ice on his shoulder.

yeti_lands.name: Ruughal the Singer
yeti_lands.role: The singer whose song carried second furthest at the last winter gathering, and who has been practising ever since.
yeti_lands.succession: The clans follow the singer whose song carries furthest at the winter gathering.
yeti_lands.portrait: A white-furred yeti with his head thrown back mid-song, frost in his mane.

ghaahu.name: Halgarum the High Singer
ghaahu.role: Sings the height clans' herd-calls and is said to sing them further each winter; men are not told when the song changes, and they will not be told this time either.
ghaahu.succession: The height clans follow the singer whose song carries furthest.
ghaahu.portrait: A grey-furred mountain yeti on a snow ledge, a carved horn at his side.

vindael.name: Ulvbran Hozen
vindael.role: Branak's cousin has kept the gale watch of Porideon for six seasons, and the captains who elect the speaker owe him their lives more often than they like.
vindael.succession: The captains of Porideon elect a Speaker for each gale season.
vindael.portrait: A salt-crusted captain in a storm cloak with a brass horn.

dondor.name: Dunbar of the Gulung
dondor.role: Dunmar's eldest son, broad as a doorway and trained by the beacon-wardens; the Barand and the Urdung say the Gulung have held the crown long enough, and they are counting their men.
dondor.succession: The clan-moot chooses each king from the strongest line of the moment.
dondor.portrait: A massive young man in black iron scale with a beacon-brand on his forearm.

dark_gate.name: Ghorzak of Doldes
dark_gate.role: The strongest of Ghorlak's gate-captains and the likeliest to break him in the ring one day; Cocanoor has already sent him a gift, which everyone at the gate noticed.
dark_gate.succession: A gate-chief holds the gate-fort until a stronger challenger breaks him in the ring; the Warking confirms him.
dark_gate.portrait: A scarred orc in volcanic-black mail with a gate-key on a chain.

burnikit.name: Snaxit Loud-Lamp
burnikit.role: Already the second-loudest boss in the warrens and working hard on first place; Skritix has had him watched, which he takes as a compliment.
burnikit.succession: Each Big Snik is the loudest and cleverest boss the warrens will follow.
burnikit.portrait: A wiry goblin with a brass lamp held high and his mouth wide open.

veshazel.name: Vorzael the Pact-Bound
veshazel.role: The pact names him the hall's next lord, or so the heralds say; what the pact asked in return is the pact's business, and nobody in Veshazel asks twice.
veshazel.succession: Pact-lords with hidden pact-names hold the hall; how the hall passes is the pact's business.
veshazel.portrait: A horned demon lord with ash-grey skin and pact-sigils burned along his arms.

blackton.name: Gorvan Korvik
blackton.role: The burgher who has sat beside the moot-speaker at every moot this year and lent the town more silver than anyone else; the moot chooses again at the year's end, and his creditors vote.
blackton.succession: The town moot chooses a moot-speaker each year.
blackton.portrait: A heavy burgher in a dark fur-trimmed gown with a ring of gate-keys.

belonton.name: Ugrash the Far-Sailor
belonton.role: The captain with the most voyages after Rukhag's own, who came home from the last one with a hold full of bells from somebody's temple.
belonton.succession: The holds choose the Sea-Chief for the voyages he has won.
belonton.portrait: A sea-orc with salt-bleached braids, a boarding axe and a temple bell at his belt.

bordon.name: Zhagdur of Zubudor
bordon.role: Has won every ring-fight at the Zubudor inns for three years and says loudly that he is saving the last one for Gruzash.
bordon.succession: A road-chief keeps the iron and the ring until he is challenged.
bordon.portrait: A heavy orc fighter bare to the waist with ring-scars and iron wrist-bands.

dreson.name: Mudrak Eel-Son
dreson.role: Mudgash's nephew, raised among the eel-weirs; the reed-council likes him because he listens, which Mudgash has never done.
dreson.succession: The reed-council chooses a chief to keep the iron and the ring, and can unmake him.
dreson.portrait: A fen orc in reed-woven armour with an eel-spear.

dulundur.name: Ghorvak of the Second Valley
dulundur.role: The chief of the second valley, who has kept his fire through two challenges and is the one the hall would likely set over the other three.
dulundur.succession: Four chiefs, one for each valley, each holds his fire until challenged; the hall chooses one to speak for all.
dulundur.portrait: A grizzled hill orc with a fire-blackened shield and a chief's torc.

troll_forest.name: Krunch the Unbeaten
troll_forest.role: The largest troll in the forest after Smash, and the only one who has never been beaten; he has not yet tried Smash, and the forest is waiting to see whether he will.
troll_forest.succession: The oldest unbeaten troll leads each group; the king is the largest troll of the forest.
troll_forest.portrait: A towering moss-backed troll with a club made from a whole young tree.

hoorunoron.name: Bruuntar the Old
hoorunoron.role: The giant next in age after Dorunas, who has kept the river cairns since before the first men came to count them.
hoorunoron.succession: The oldest giant keeps the line of cairns.
hoorunoron.portrait: A craggy primeval giant with a mossy stone-like hide, leaning on a standing stone.

the_darks.name: Zugrak of the Second Hold
the_darks.office: Chief of the Second Forest Hold
the_darks.role: The chief of the second forest hold, whom the ogre clan-heads like because he feeds them well; the moot will need the ogres' nod, and he already has it.
the_darks.succession: Four orc chiefs and the ogre clan-heads sit in one moot; the orcs speak for the holds.
the_darks.portrait: A forest orc in bark-dyed leather with an ogre-tooth necklace.

skragdurg.name: Grumbag Oak-Feller
skragdurg.role: Felled the great oak of Colost with his own axe last winter, which makes him fit to be chief, and has been sharpening the axe since, which makes Grumzag nervous.
skragdurg.succession: Chiefs hold the forest-hold until challenged; each must have felled a great tree with his own axe.
skragdurg.portrait: A muscular orc with a huge felling axe and wood-chips in his hair.

dun.name: Ruzbag of the Zhaggul
dun.role: Bordesk's eldest son, who has the toll-king's blood and the toll-king's temper; his brothers have the blood too, and the ring at Dobudo will settle which of them keeps the channel.
dun.succession: The crown goes to the son of the Zhaggul who wins the ring.
dun.portrait: A young orc prince with a toll-chain over his shoulder and a ring-fighter's stance.

britadon.name: Bazrak of the Brakgul
britadon.role: The Brakgul who broke three challengers in the ring this year, and the only one Karguk no longer invites to drink.
britadon.succession: Chiefs of the Brakgul hold the iron and the ring until challenged.
britadon.portrait: An orc smith-warrior with ore-stained hands and an iron-banded maul.

wild_lands.name: Ghashrok of the Doltu
wild_lands.role: Holds the second winter camp with the biggest band on the moor and means to be at Zudertu first when the snow comes.
wild_lands.succession: Whoever holds the winter camp at Zudertu when the snow comes speaks for the moor until the thaw.
wild_lands.portrait: A moor orc wrapped in snow-crusted hides with a bone-hafted spear.

rhachia.name: Alerhis of Gaenna
rhachia.role: The village head the kiln-villages send to every assembly and the tribune they mean to elect at the next seventh year; Prince Mirodan's friends at Porrenva call him a potter with ideas.
rhachia.portrait: A sun-browned villager in a clay-red tunic with a kiln-master's tongs.

mora.name: Ernoeus of Gonnois
mora.role: The salt-pan master's son, whom the lake towns have already asked to stand when Alerh's three years are out.
mora.succession: Elective, three years (the lake towns' council).
mora.portrait: A plump townsman in white linen with a salt-merchant's seal.

kersian.name: Velmeus Kersides
kersian.role: Alerh's cousin and the market council's favourite for next year's lantern, since he has never once lost a ledger.
kersian.portrait: A neat merchant in a blue robe holding a brass market lantern.

mostok.name: Tablio Crovo
mostok.role: The First Weigher's nephew, who holds the second scale and expects the first; the weighers say he is honest, which in Mostok is said with some surprise.
mostok.portrait: A sharp-faced caravan merchant in green silk with a set of brass weights.

obmi.name: Arcino Shindo
obmi.role: The ablest factor of the Shindo after Narino himself, who knows every gum-tapper of the jungle edge by name.
obmi.succession: Elective for life (the council of factors).
obmi.portrait: A heavy-lidded factor in a light jungle coat with a pouch of resin.

pornivior.name: Belino Shindo
pornivior.role: Pelio's cousin, the tithe-warden the guilds trust most with their coin and least with their secrets.
pornivior.portrait: A guild warden in a sober grey coat with a tithe-chest key.

woqood.name: Nurek ben Alodim
woqood.role: Alodim's son, who threw his first harpoon this winter and has already been asked to stand by two of the boat clans, who like to choose early.
woqood.portrait: A boy in sealskin with a child's harpoon and a fur-lined hood.

khorvrath.name: Vorzuum the Ash-Crowned
khorvrath.office: First Thrall-Lord of the Horned Court
khorvrath.role: The strongest of the thrall-lords of the Horned Court, who already sits a step below the horn-seat and has never pretended he does not want the step.
khorvrath.portrait: A tall horned demon in blackened bronze with a crown of ash-white horn.

dolon.name: Khorzael of the Salt Pact
dolon.role: The pact has named him the next to rule Dolon, the scribes say, and the queen has not contradicted the pact, which is as close to an answer as Dolon gives.
dolon.succession: By pact (the House of the Salt Pact).
dolon.portrait: A slender demon prince with salt-white skin and pact-script on his robes.

halia.name: Maelen of Gelon
halia.role: The headman of the salt-pans of Gelon, whom the other freeholds would accept if only because he is not from Bennen.
halia.portrait: A dusty freeholder in a salt-stained smock with a headman's staff.

olen.name: Almon of the High Lamp
olen.role: Keeps the highest of the cliff lamps, the one the boats steer by first, and the lamp-keepers have long said that whoever keeps it keeps the rest.
olen.portrait: A spare man in a smoke-dark robe holding a shielded lamp.

enhis_is_rond.name: Kenyo nau Suyowan
enhis_is_rond.role: The second of the tally-keepers of the drowned shrine, who can read every knot the elders ever tied and is expected to tie the next ones.
enhis_is_rond.succession: The tally-keepers choose the Priest-Elder from among themselves.
enhis_is_rond.portrait: An islander priest with knotted tally-cords over his shoulder and shell earrings.

howan.name: Tichyo nau Lamowan
howan.role: The terrace-head whose terraces never ran dry in the last bad season, which on Howan is the best argument a man can make.
howan.succession: The moot of terrace-heads chooses a Speaker for as long as the terraces are well watered.
howan.portrait: A farmer of the terraces with a water-gourd and a woven sun-hat.

verde.name: Lanyo nau Lua
verde.role: Ruan's sister-son, who sailed to the edge of the islands' charts and came back to say the charts were wrong.
verde.succession: The clans choose a chief who has sailed to the edge of the islands' charts.
verde.portrait: A young navigator with a stick-chart and a sun-bleached sail-cloth wrap.

nara.name: Wangai nau Ancha
nara.role: The next-eldest of the elders of Ancha, only a few winters younger than Panui, and the moot has already begun to send him its questions.
nara.succession: The eldest of the elders sent by the villages of Ancha speaks for the island.
nara.portrait: A white-haired island elder leaning on a carved staff.

yongyong.name: Tonyo nau Yongwa
yongyong.role: The village elder who calls the ring when Howo is away, and whom the Yong villages are already used to obeying.
yongyong.succession: The elder of Yongwa calls the ring-council; every Yong village sends its elder.
yongyong.portrait: An islander elder with a carved shell gorget and a feather fan.

kamu_lamo.name: Rumang nau Bukonyo
kamu_lamo.role: The first of the keepers of the tally-caves, who knows the deep cave better than any man alive and goes into it alone.
kamu_lamo.succession: The keepers of the tally-caves choose the elder from among themselves.
kamu_lamo.portrait: A grey-bearded cave-keeper with a torch and cord tallies.

kea.name: Keawan nau Tuwang
kea.role: Keeps the highest rice terraces of Kea and their cisterns, and the terrace council would rather trust its water to him than to anyone else.
kea.succession: The terrace council chooses a Water-Keeper each dry season.
kea.portrait: A rice farmer with a cistern-key and a rain cape of palm leaves.

sidea.name: Lanuan nau Pon
sidea.role: Beats the summons for Nuoan from the watch-rocks, and the families say the drums will answer him the day they stop answering Nuoan.
sidea.succession: One elder is chosen by the families of all the islets and holds office until the drummers will no longer beat his summons.
sidea.portrait: An islander drummer with a slit-drum and red-ochre markings.

lands_of_light.name: Helan of Eldoga
lands_of_light.role: The first of the readers of the sanctuary of Eldoga, whom the other sanctuaries send their questions when the Radiant Speaker is silent.
lands_of_light.portrait: A sun elf in white and gold with a reader's scroll-case.

elvana.name: Telang of Googavis
elvana.office: Keeper of the Looms of Googavis
elvana.role: Keeps the sanctuary looms where the sun-banners are woven, and the sanctuary of Googavis has already asked him to sit at the Speaker's right hand.
elvana.portrait: A sun elf weaver in saffron robes with a shuttle of golden thread.

igara.name: Rangel of Repgin
igara.role: Keeps the shallows where the cranes of the shrine feed, and the sanctuary of Repgin likes a Speaker who does not hurry.
igara.portrait: A sun elf in a pale robe with a crane feather in his hair.

yeni_alang.name: Wenel of Sudoni
yeni_alang.role: The next-eldest of the watchers of Sudoni, who has kept the high watch for longer than any kingdom of men has stood.
yeni_alang.portrait: A sun elf watcher in sky-blue with a long brass far-glass.

tor_luni.name: Lovan of Wefolen
tor_luni.role: The mason who resets the standing stones of Wefolen after every flood, and whom the sanctuary would choose to keep them all.
tor_luni.portrait: A sun elf mason with stone dust on his robes and a chisel at his belt.

ihuy.name: Pangel of Holang
ihuy.role: Speaks for Holang in the council of island speakers and is the one the other islands find least objectionable, which is how the council chooses.
ihuy.portrait: A sun elf islander with a reef-pilot's staff and pearl beads.

soyano.name: Selan of Ileslia
soyano.role: The master steersman of the white ships of Ileslia, whom the shipwrights and steersmen of the council would raise as Tide-Speaker without a second vote.
soyano.portrait: A sun elf pilot in white sailcloth with a star-wheel.

goodin.name: Hengel of Goodton
goodin.role: The elder of the largest guest-town, whose house has fed every traveller on the grass road for three generations.
goodin.portrait: A broad-faced host of the guest-towns in a grass-green coat.

magical_forest.name: Taurel Lozari
magical_forest.role: The head of House Lozari, the second house of the council, whom the houses tired of the Velakorin would vote for, if any house were ever tired of anything quickly.
magical_forest.portrait: A silver-haired forest elf in leaf-green with the Lozari star on his clasp.

andos_enda.name: Ferwen of the Weirs
andos_enda.role: Speaks for the weir groves of the lake and is expected to take the lake's name when the groves next choose a Speaker.
andos_enda.portrait: A lake elf in water-blue with river reeds braided into his hair.

nolorim.name: Sirion of the Western Posts
nolorim.role: The post-captain of the western passes, whose posts have never been surprised, and whom the other captains would elect without a long debate.
nolorim.portrait: An elf warden in grey and green with a long bow and a pass-horn.

lccimio.name: Thalwen of the Orchards
lccimio.role: The eldest of the orchard houses, whose turn it is next, and who has been patient about it for a very long time.
lccimio.portrait: A coastal elf in russet with a pruning knife and apple blossom.

eldafaen.name: Aelwen of Lenkei
eldafaen.role: The first copyist of the archive of Lenkei, who has copied the Book of the Fallen three times and corrected it twice.
eldafaen.portrait: An elf scholar with ink-stained fingers and a satchel of scrolls.

yavieth.name: Kaereth the Elder Keeper
yavieth.role: The next-eldest of the roost-keepers, to whom the dragons already turn their heads when he climbs the roost paths.
yavieth.portrait: An elf keeper in scale-patterned leather with a dragon-tooth staff.

teste.name: Aldwin Selbar
teste.role: Edovan's cousin keeps the harvest rolls of the commune, and the harvest moot has a habit of choosing whoever kept the rolls last.
teste.portrait: A farmer of the Teste Vale with a ledger and an elf-made bow.

luv_zhise.name: Thalides Moiros
luv_zhise.role: The head of the temple quay-house, whose families' turn it is next; the river families are already looking for a reason to say it is not.
luv_zhise.portrait: A temple-family merchant in white and blue with a quay-house seal.

selen.name: Calden Svenlor
selen.role: Daeric's son, whom the house of Svenlor will put before the moots; he is a fair ranger and a better speaker, and he has been careful to stand where Alleria's rangers can see him.
selen.portrait: A young ranger in a green hooded cloak with the Svenlor oak-leaf at his shoulder.

hirolon.name: Oronar of the Elder Cairn
hirolon.role: Keeps the elder cairn of the High Chiefs, which counts for a great deal when a dispute is judged by which party can name the older cairn.
hirolon.portrait: A hill giant with a stone-like hide and moss on his shoulders, a cairn-stone in his hands.

tirlan.name: Hobbard Brumel
tirlan.role: The householder of the north fields, whose harvest was the best in Tirlan three years running, which the moot remembers better than speeches.
tirlan.portrait: A round-faced small-folk farmer in a patched waistcoat with a sheaf of barley.

klungori_guard.name: Aldric Toler
klungori_guard.role: The captain of the lamp watch on the pilgrim road, whom the sworn trust because he has never lost a pilgrim in the tunnels.
klungori_guard.portrait: A guard captain in a lamp-black cloak with a hooded lantern and a short spear.

noleksun.name: Tannor Ulren
noleksun.role: The speaker of the town of Saelori, from a family that has never held the chief speakership and so may, by the custom of the eight towns.
noleksun.portrait: A plain townsman of the march in a brown coat with a speaker's ribbon.

kilinti.name: Oonothar
kilinti.role: An ent of Kilinti who has said four words this year, two of them to a beetle; by the moot's reckoning that makes him the likeliest Eldest after Gronnar.
kilinti.portrait: A vast bark-skinned ent with lichen in his beard and a sleeping bird on one branch.

safeton.name: Ronvar Safarel
safeton.office: Heir of the House of Safarel
safeton.role: Ronric's son, who would like the council to choose a Safarel again and knows that the council's eyes are on the head of the house of Lotaren.
safeton.portrait: A young ship-house heir in a blue doublet with a harbour chain.

freshon.name: Ervan Sulren
freshon.role: The spring-master whose name the city expects to come out of the urn at the next drawing, which in Freshon means only that he has bribed nobody yet.
freshon.portrait: A spring-master in a wet-hemmed robe with a copper ladle.

pazoma.name: Hallec Bellaren
pazoma.role: The master of the bell-founders, who hold the first seat among the guilds, and the warden's nephew besides.
pazoma.portrait: A burly bell-founder in a scorched leather apron with a bronze hand-bell.

orohaf.name: Belvar Rishan
orohaf.role: The young man the eldest women of the five houses have let it be known they favour; nobody on the isle mistakes that for a promise.
orohaf.succession: Elective among the five houses (the eldest women choose).
orohaf.portrait: A young islander lord in sea-grey with a carved whale-bone pin.

kunhrim.name: Hrunmar of the Hrunord
kunhrim.role: A Hrunord whom the council of clan-elders has watched at the forge for longer than a man lives; the Kramast think the Deep Hall should stay theirs.
kunhrim.succession: Elective among the clans (the council of clan-elders).
kunhrim.portrait: A stout dwarf with a braided forge-singed beard and a rune-marked hammer.

burrikkrit.name: Krunkit the Big
burrikkrit.office: Biggest in the Throne-Cave but One
burrikkrit.role: The biggest hobgoblin in the throne-cave after Dwibrik, and growing; the king has started sitting further back on the throne.
burrikkrit.portrait: A hulking hobgoblin in scavenged plate with a wurgh-hide cloak.

olodor.name: Pebbit of Tovodor
olodor.role: Pebbo's sister-son, whom the gold-crowned of Tovodor has already measured for a crown, very discreetly.
olodor.portrait: A small gnome with a neat white beard and a garden trowel at his belt.

dunelaeth.name: Thaurel of Thamiel
dunelaeth.role: The elf the houses of Thamiel would choose if Velaeth ever laid down her charge, a guide of the kingdom forests who has led every lost traveller out of them.
dunelaeth.portrait: A forest elf guide in moss-green with a staff of living wood.

aenor_forest.name: Hulmor of Graulvoa
aenor_forest.role: The eldest of the second-oldest stand, who will speak for the whole forest when Goarvom no longer can, and who has already begun to speak more slowly.
aenor_forest.succession: By the slow moot of the stands.
aenor_forest.portrait: A tall Baelim of grey bark and needles, his face a knot in an old trunk.

cursed_lands.name: Belzan of the Eldest Cord
cursed_lands.role: Keeps the eldest cord when Izkala walks the wells, and the council of cord-mothers has let him keep it longer each year.
cursed_lands.succession: The council of cord-mothers names the next keeper of the eldest cord.
cursed_lands.portrait: A veiled man of the Cursed Lands with a knotted cord wound round his wrist.

bloody_forest.name: Gorzek, son of Belz
bloody_forest.role: The man the cord-mothers have marked to lead the next raid, which in the Redbark clans is as near to an heir as a war-chief comes.
bloody_forest.portrait: A Redbark warrior with red-ochre bark paint and an antler-handled axe.

eekedor.name: Agnar Perdal
eekedor.role: The banker who holds the salt-pans' debts, whom the counting houses mean to choose when Pertav's five years end, if he does not buy the choice first.
eekedor.succession: The council of counting houses chooses a Speaker for five years.
eekedor.portrait: A Leren banker in a dark wool coat with a salt-white collar and an abacus.

heodwa_lands.name: King Torvald of Heodwa
heodwa_lands.role: The king of Heodwa, whom the council at Pand will choose to speak for the hills if it does not choose Ingmund again.
heodwa_lands.succession: The three hill crowns keep their own kings; the council chooses one of them to speak for the hills.
heodwa_lands.portrait: A hill king in a fur-trimmed mantle with a plain iron circlet.

hrakbrund.name: Hradek Ilmord
hrakbrund.house: the Ilmord lords of the White Hall
hrakbrund.role: The lord's kinsman of the eldest delving line, whom the White Hall has shown at its gate; how the hold will choose its next lord, it does not tell men.
hrakbrund.succession: The lord of the eldest delving line rules; the hold does not tell men how its heirs are chosen.
hrakbrund.portrait: A dwarf in white-enamelled mail with a beard braided in silver rings.

dolpar.name: Hegmund of Stork
dolpar.role: The judge of Stork, whose judgments the lake-court has overturned less often than any other's, and whom the judges will likely set to preside.
dolpar.succession: Each lake town sends a judge to the lake-court, and the judges choose one of themselves to preside.
dolpar.portrait: A lake-town judge in a black gown with a carved wooden gavel.

mustnom.name: Vurmok the Cave-Taker
mustnom.role: Took the ridge cave from its last boss in one night and has been looking at the cave of Krakur ever since.
mustnom.succession: Whoever takes the cave of Krakur becomes first among the bosses.
mustnom.portrait: A squat dwarf goblin in dented iron with a pick and a lamp-cap.

wahatud.name: Barqan ben Shinud
wahatud.role: The man of the Shinud well, whose clan's turn it is next at the Well-Moot, and who has already sent dates to every clan-father.
wahatud.portrait: A desert clansman in indigo with a water-skin and a camel stick.

adel.name: Hesaros Andaios
adel.role: The best chart-master of the Andaios chart-house, whom the other houses would elect if only the Andaios had not held the speakership so long.
adel.succession: Adel's chart-houses elect the Speaker from the master-pilots.
adel.portrait: A Triton pilot in a sea-green coat with a chart-case and a brass compass.

raerby.name: Kilaros Raeros
raerby.role: Daios's nephew, who keeps the family's ships and its freight-book honest, which the shipowners have noticed.
raerby.succession: The shipowners choose a Captain-Speaker for as long as he keeps the freight-book honestly.
raerby.portrait: A shipowner's heir in a blue coat with a sealed freight-book.

pollos.name: Pamaros Polai
pollos.house: the Polai family, keepers of the strong-room
pollos.role: Pamon's son, whom the Polai expect the guild-masters to choose, as they have chosen a Polai for most of the market's life.
pollos.succession: The guild-masters of the trades choose the first among them.
pollos.portrait: A young merchant with a strong-room key and a money-belt.

fineger.name: Lemaron Finon
fineger.house: the Finon family of the Kile Islands
fineger.role: Has steered a ship through the Poolho ice twice, which makes him fit to be chosen and the Finon family keen that he should be.
fineger.succession: The master-pilots choose a Speaker who has piloted a ship through the Poolho ice.
fineger.portrait: An ice-pilot in heavy oiled wool with a sounding pole.

windy_lands.name: Benarai of Sondor
windy_lands.role: Benaios's brother holds the inner cape and its wrecking-lights, and the cape-lords would choose him for any gale season his brother let pass.
windy_lands.succession: Four cape-lords sit in council at Audailon and choose one to speak for the league each gale season.
windy_lands.portrait: A corsair lord in a weather-stained coat with a wrecker's lantern.

seite_islands.name: Raesion of Vesko
seite_islands.role: Reads the moot-roll at Vesko when Arai is hoarse, which happens more every year, and the households have got used to his voice.
seite_islands.succession: The moot of every household chooses a moot-reader each year.
seite_islands.portrait: An islander in a plain wool tunic with a moot-roll.

santon.name: Hanaios the Black
santon.role: The best of Dairos's captains and the one with the most ships of his own; the outer arc goes to whoever takes it, and he has not been shy about counting.
santon.succession: The best captain holds the outer arc by the sword until a better one comes.
santon.portrait: A corsair captain in black leather with a curved boarding sword.

benan.name: Kildaros of the Coves
benan.role: The corsair who pays the haven the most in dues, which in Benan is the nearest thing to a claim on the captaincy.
benan.succession: The haven chooses its captain from the corsairs who pay its dues.
benan.portrait: A corsair in a red sash with a purse of dues-coins and a cove-pilot's pole.

the_lens.name: Arnaros of the North Tower
the_lens.role: Kept the north tower lit through the worst gale season anyone remembers, and the order has not forgotten it.
the_lens.succession: The order chooses its Keeper from the lamp-keepers who have kept a tower through a whole gale season.
the_lens.portrait: A lamp-keeper in a soot-dark cloak with a lens of polished glass.

gunwyn.name: Herlow ap Herlic
gunwyn.role: Herlic's eldest son and the Rookwyn's choice; the Werlwyn of Werlendor will say the crown is theirs to give, and his father has started counting the Werlwyn's spears.
gunwyn.succession: The clan moot chooses each king from among the dead king's kin.
gunwyn.portrait: A young clan prince in a checked plaid with a rook-feather brooch.

girdon.name: Rawlic Lothor
girdon.role: The warden of the upper Lothoro valley, whose riders the other ford-wardens would follow if Branow stepped down.
girdon.succession: The ford-wardens choose a Warden-Speaker from among themselves.
girdon.portrait: A river warden in a grey riding cloak with a ford-staff.

werlendor.name: Dyfow ap Dyfric
werlendor.role: Dyfric's only son, still a boy; the Werlwyn kin will choose from the dead king's family at the Erg stone, and some of them already say a boy is too young for the claim to Bulligon.
werlendor.succession: The Werlwyn kin choose the king from the dead king's family at the Erg stone.
werlendor.portrait: A boy in a hill-clan plaid too long for him, with a small iron torc.

thenon.name: Cadow ap Cadlic
thenon.role: Cadlic's son, a child of the royal hall at Tummin whom the moot will have to weigh against grown men of the Sarudwyn kin.
thenon.succession: The clan moot chooses among the Sarudwyn kin.
thenon.portrait: A young boy in green with a wooden practice sword.

dobbum.name: Wobbel Stubbel
dobbum.role: Bolm's son, who keeps the household's orchard and hopes the moot at Luddum will remember the apples.
dobbum.succession: The moot of householders chooses a Warden for as long as the Warden keeps the harvest good.
dobbum.portrait: A cheerful small-folk man with an apple basket and a green felt hat.

brundahrim.name: Hrokast Durnast
brundahrim.house: the Durnast lords of the deepest hall
brundahrim.role: The kinsman of the deepest hall whom the Durnast have let men see at the factor-houses; how the hold will choose its next lord, it does not tell men.
brundahrim.succession: The lord of the eldest delving line rules; the hold does not tell men how its heirs are chosen.
brundahrim.portrait: A dark-bearded dwarf in soot-black mail with a powder-flask at his belt.

gromkerm.name: Stulkorn Kunerm
gromkerm.role: The gate-warden's kinsman, who keeps the outer gate-forts and is the only Kunerm men have seen there in years; how the hall chooses, it does not say.
gromkerm.succession: The Kunerm line of fort-wardens rules from the deep hall; men are not told how.
gromkerm.portrait: A dwarf gate-warden in heavy plate with a great key and a bombardier's linstock.

saopon.name: Gwedlow Pellkow
saopon.role: The First Guildsman's cousin, who reads the guild book when old Gwedric's eyes fail him, and whom the boatmen's councils have begun to cheer.
saopon.succession: The guild councils of the Kulolo towns elect a First Guildsman.
saopon.portrait: A boatman guildsman in a tarred jerkin with a guild-book under his arm.

buldor.name: Holtric of the Grey Banner
buldor.office: Second Captain of the Grey Banner
buldor.role: Tarnic's second, who has kept the contract-book and the paymaster's chest honest through four campaigns, which the company-lords value above courage.
buldor.succession: The company-lords elect a Captain-General; law is the contract-book.
buldor.portrait: A mercenary captain in grey half-plate with a contract scroll at his belt.

kradlon.name: Kelnic Tanuow
kradlon.role: Brannic's nephew keeps the powder rolls of the guild, and the council at Bolbin trusts nobody else to count the casks.
kradlon.succession: The guild council of Bolbin elects a First Guildsman.
kradlon.portrait: A powder-master in a leather apron with a powder-horn and a tally-board.

corogon.name: Doranic Gwennow
corogon.office: Heir of the House of Gwennow
corogon.role: The heir of the House of Gwennow, who will stand for consul as soon as his house has waited out the three-in-ten rule.
corogon.succession: The great houses choose two consuls each year.
corogon.portrait: A young patrician in a dark red cloak with a consul's ring.

wennarith.name: Ruarow of the Datidon
wennarith.role: Keeps the Datidon ferry when Branow sits in council, and the ferry-wardens have taken to calling him by the speaker's name in jest.
wennarith.succession: The ferry-wardens choose a Warden-Speaker from among themselves.
wennarith.portrait: A ferry-warden in a river cloak with a pole and a wardens' token.
